title: Zeus Grime Wipes – 20 Pack
description:
Keep your units and accessories in tip top shape with the ZEUS Wipes.

Each pack comes with 20 ethanol soaked cleaning wipes, perfect for glass, ceramic, and metal.

Works with any vaporizer component that can be cleaned with ethyl alcohol (metal, glass and ceramic)

Package Contents: 20 x Grime Wipes
